svg.title: A child with ataxia: localize it (hemisphere for limb ataxia, vermis for truncal ataxia), then sort the three most common causes (intoxication, acute postinfectious cerebellar ataxia, brain tumour) from the can't-miss causes (stroke or hemorrhage, meningitis or encephalitis, brain tumour) by the history; each column says whether to image and what to do, with the exam of a young child and Friedreich ataxia below

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Child with ataxia: a SIGN, not a diagnosis

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cerebellum: trouble walking or sitting, falls to one side, slurred speech, low tone, intention tremor

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cerebellar HEMISPHERE → limbs: over- or undershoots, clumsy · VERMIS → trunk: can't sit, wide-based gait

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: also from vestibular disease (severe vertigo, vomiting, positional) or weakness, sensory or position-sense loss

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: by stage: not walking → can't sit unsupported, misreaches · walking → wide-based, unsteady, clumsy, dysmetria, intention

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: IMAGE (MRI preferred, CT more accessible) if: ANY other neurologic finding · SUBACUTE course (weeks to months) ·

svg.text: • dysmetria: reach for a favourite toy or food with each hand · watch for tremor

svg.text: • nystagmus: follow a toy across the visual field

svg.text: • sensation: poke a foot while distracted, does the child look?

svg.text: • gait: caregiver steps away · toddlers are wide-based anyway, ask if it is NEW
